name: LinuxToys
description:
LinuxToys is a collection of user-friendly performance tweaks, system configuration tools, and optimization scripts for Linux desktops. It simplifies common administration and gaming optimization tasks through an intuitive graphical menu.

Features:
- One-click performance tweaks for Linux gaming (gamemode, wine-staging, proton)
- Kernel and scheduler tuning for reduced desktop latency and better responsiveness
- Automated installation of popular gaming utilities, runtimes, and dependencies
- Clean graphical interface with modular scripts for safe application and rollback
- Helpful diagnostics and system hardware information readouts
